Antwerpen

Saturday 19 December 2026

On Saturday 19 December, the beach of Sint-Anna in Antwerp sets the scene for the fourth round of the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup. The Antwerp sand promises to be the first major test for the specialists. Last year, Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel were the strongest. Who will make the difference this year?

Tickets

Would you like to join us in Antwerp on Saturday 19 December? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Presale: €21.50 (service fee included)

On race day, both at the on-site ticket office and online: €25.00 (service fee included)

Children born in 2014 or later can enter for free, but must still order a child ticket.

 

[GO TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://antwerpen.tickets.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/selection?language=en)

Hospitality

Practical information

Address

Thonetlaan, 2050 Antwerp

 

Do you have a question?

Contact the organisation [here](https://www.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/en/contact).

How to get there?

By bike

A bicycle parking area is available at Thonetlaan 32, 2050 Antwerp. Be sure to bring a bike lock.

 

By train

From Antwerpen-Linkeroever station, it's about a 15-minute walk to the course.

 

By bus

Take bus line 36 and get off at the Antwerpen Gloriantlaan stop. Plan your bus journey [here](https://www.delijn.be/en/routeplanner/).

 

By car

Coming from Ghent? Take the E17 and exit at junction 17 (Zwijndrecht). If you're coming via the Kennedy Tunnel, follow the Parallelweg to exit 6 (Linkeroever). Then follow the signage to Blancefloerlaan.
